Markets.title: Geraldine Weiss’s dividend strategy: The blue-chip investing formula that stood the 'Test of Time'
Markets.summary: Geraldine Weiss developed a value-investing strategy focused on purchasing financially strong blue-chip stocks when their dividend yields exceeded historical averages. Her disciplined approach relied on consistent dividend growth, reasonable valuations, moderate debt, and patience to generate income and spot undervalued investments.

Markets.title: Big Bull's magic: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala turned Rs 1 crore into Rs 20 crore overnight after the 1989 budget

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation decreased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation rates for primary articles and manufactured products both increased compared to June.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India’s merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation decreased to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation may provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding future interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, compounded by risks from elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong economic growth outlook. The agency also projected India's GDP growth at 6.4% while highlighting fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment.

India.title: After Hyderabad, Top Bengaluru Law College Opposes Invitation To Chief Justice
